title: Staged runbook for fast-fail validations
summary: Lightweight, stage-gated runbook for running time-boxed customer POC experiments that validate viability quickly and gracefully fail when minimum success criteria are not met.
objectives: Validate core integration within 72 hours (API + auth + sample requests)
Confirm latency and throughput at target QPS within 5x of production SLA
Measure quality on a seeded prompt set (recall/precision-ish signals) vs baseline
Surface infra/cost blockers early so we can recommend Dedicated vs Hosted
scope: This runbook is scoped to the initial 3-week POC engagement for mid-market customers evaluating Redwood Hosted API. It covers lab checks, customer workshop agenda, gated tests, and an escalation path to Solutions Eng and Platform teams. Not included: full dedicated deployment runbook or legal/compliance approvals.
timeline:
Week 0 (pre-POC): prep checklist and sample data ingest; Week 1: wire-up + smoke tests (fast-fail gates); Week 2: load validations + quality sweeps; Week 3: handoff + recommendation brief. See milestone list below.

Milestones:
- Day -3: Customer sends sample dataset and success metrics
- Day 0: Kickoff workshop + environment provisioned
- Day 2: Basic end-to-end generation verified (gate A)
- Day 5: Latency baseline and cost estimate (gate B)
- Day 12: Throughput tests (gate C)
- Day 18: Quality evals and final recommendation
- Day 21: Handoff doc and next-step decision

acceptance_criteria: Gate A (smoke): API returns valid JSON in < 1s p50 for 1-shot prompts
Gate B (latency): p95 latency <= 2x customer SLA for target prompt lengths
Gate C (throughput): no crashes at target QPS for 10-minute sustained window
Quality gate: ≥ 70% of seeded prompts meet customer-defined pass condition OR clear remediation path documented
Security gate: sample dataset sanitized and agreement signed or DHL verified
risks_and_mitigations: Unexpected dataset size leading to token explosion -> mitigation: sample and truncate pipeline + run local tokenizer estimate before provisioning
GPU OOMs on long context -> mitigation: test with incremental KV cache and cap max_seq, recommend quantized model variant
Customer success metrics unclear -> mitigation: run 1-hour alignment workshop and record examples for thresholding
Network egress constraints for private data -> mitigation: propose VPC peering or Dedicated trial with data isolation
workshop_agenda:
Kickoff (30m): goals, success metrics, and dataset expectations
Hands-on lab (60m): engineer-to-engineer wire-up and smoke tests
Break (15m)
Validation session (45m): run seeded prompts and review outputs
Ops sync (30m): latency, cost, routing options and next-step decisions
Wrap & action items (15m): owners and DD schedule
checkpoints: Day 2 check-in: Gate A status and immediate blockers
Day 6 check-in: latency summary and cost projection
Day 13 check-in: throughput stability and infra notes
Day 17 check-in: quality sweep midpoint and remediation plan
observability_hooks: Enable token-level tracing for test runs, instrument p50/p95 counters, and attach one sample trace per failed test. Export GPU metrics (util, mem) to the engagement dashboard.
escalation_path: If Gate B or C fails irrecoverably, open SE-urgent Slack channel and tag eng-infra/SRE; if quality gate fails, escalate to applied-ml with labeled failure cases and request triage ticket (JIRA SE-4821).
next_steps: Confirm customer sample data received and sanitized
Reserve 1x GPU node for Week 1 smoke tests (SRE ticket)
Ship ephemeral API key + README to customer
Schedule Day 0 kickoff with customer and product manager
notes_to_self: Keep experiments minimal and measurable. If a single critical gate fails, capture artifacts and present a clean go/no-go to the customer within 24 hours. Avoid large-scale infra changes during fast-fail phase.
